title: Kantano target is not scraped
expr: ((max by (job) (1 - up{environment="production",job=~"kantano-api|kantano-outbox-publisher|kantano-celery-worker|integrations/unix|integrations/postgres|integrations/redis|integrations/cadvisor|rabbitmq"})) or ((label_replace(vector(1), "job", "kantano-api", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "job", "kantano-outbox-publisher", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "job", "kantano-celery-worker", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "job", "integrations/unix", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "job", "integrations/postgres", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "job", "integrations/redis", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "job", "integrations/cadvisor", "", "") or label_replace(vector(1), "job", "rabbitmq", "", "")) unless on (job) max by (job) (up{environment="production"}))) and on () (count(up{environment="production",job="alloy"}) > 0)
summary: An expected scrape target is down or has disappeared for more than two minutes.

title: Kantano dependency unavailable
summary: PostgreSQL, Redis, or RabbitMQ is unavailable.

title: Kantano elevated 5xx rate
summary: HTTP 5xx exceeds 5 percent with at least five errors in five minutes.

title: Kantano slow API responses
summary: API p95 exceeds one second under meaningful traffic.

title: Kantano outbox is stuck
summary: The oldest unpublished outbox event is older than 120 seconds.

title: Kantano outbox publisher heartbeat stale
summary: The publisher has not completed a poll for more than 90 seconds.

title: Kantano outbox statistics stale
summary: Outbox aggregate statistics have not refreshed for more than 90 seconds.

title: Kantano RabbitMQ queue has no consumer
summary: RabbitMQ contains ready messages but no consumer is attached.

title: Kantano Celery task final failure
summary: At least one Celery task exhausted its retries in five minutes.

title: Kantano VPS memory low
summary: Less than ten percent of VPS memory remains available.

title: Kantano VPS disk low
summary: Less than fifteen percent of a persistent filesystem remains free.

title: Kantano container OOM detected
summary: A container OOM event was observed.

title: Kantano telemetry pipeline missing
summary: Alloy self-monitoring data has been absent for more than five minutes.

title: Kantano telemetry export failing
summary: Alloy is persistently queueing, failing, or dropping telemetry exports.

title: Kantano Grafana Cloud quota at 80 percent
expr: (max(grafanacloud_instance_active_series) / 10000 >= 0.80) or (max(grafanacloud_org_logs_usage) / 50 >= 0.80) or (max(grafanacloud_org_traces_usage) / 50 >= 0.80) or (max(grafanacloud_org_logs_usage) * scalar(days_in_month()) / scalar(day_of_month()) / 50 >= 0.80) or (max(grafanacloud_org_traces_usage) * scalar(days_in_month()) / scalar(day_of_month()) / 50 >= 0.80)
summary: Metrics active series or current/projected monthly logs or traces usage reached 80 percent of the Grafana Cloud Free allowance.
